purpose: The service provides a portal for merchants to manage their accounts, including viewing settlements, managing users and roles, requesting reports, and handling support overrides.

components.name: portal-backend
components.evidence: The service compares the authenticated caller with the owner of the requested resource and rejects the request if they do not match and no entitlement exists.

components.name: portal-db
components.evidence: portal-db and the message brokers sit in private subnets and are not publicly reachable.

components.name: Portal Gateway
components.evidence: The gateway validates tokens against Keycloak before forwarding to portal-backend.
